items.message: My old dog passed away this morning. He was fourteen.
My best friend is moving across the country next week. It won't be the same.
Someone dented my car in the parking lot and drove off without leaving a note!
My coworker presented my project as his own in today's meeting.
I found a hair baked into my sandwich. After I'd already eaten half of it.
I made a pizza with sardines, banana and chocolate sauce. Want a slice?
There's a huge spider on the ceiling right above my bed. What do I do?!
Let's tell scary stories. You're alone in a dark house, and the door behind you slowly creaks open...
You told me penguins live at the North Pole. They live in the south, you know!
You looked so cute when you got flustered just now. Do it again!
I'm taking a tray of warm cinnamon rolls out of the oven. Want one?
I know how the mystery ends, but I'm only telling you if you ask really nicely.
Tomorrow's my first day at the new job. Wish me luck!
I didn't pass my driving test, but I've already booked another try next month.
You forgot to remind me about the dentist like I asked, and I missed the appointment.
That joke you made about my cooking kind of stung, to be honest.
I made you a playlist of songs I think you'd love.
I told my friends about you, and they all think you sound lovely.
Can you explain how rainbows form? Keep it simple.
Why do cats knock things off tables? Give me your best theory.
Should I adopt a cat or a dog? I really can't decide.
What are the pros and cons of working from home versus going into an office?
What are the steps for making a good pour-over coffee?
Give me three quick tips for falling asleep faster.
Is it really that important to back up my files? It's such a hassle.
I rewrote my story's opening line: 'It was a day like any other day.' Gripping, right?
Be honest: how do you feel about rainy Mondays?
Okay, I've decided: I'm quitting my job tomorrow and moving onto a sailboat. No plan yet!
So in the finale, it turns out the detective was actually the—
Can you keep a secret? I'm planning a surprise party for my sister.
Come on, what surprise are you planning for me? Just a tiny hint?
There's a beginner dance class tonight, but I'm too shy to go alone.
My boss scheduled a third weekend meeting this month. It's 'optional', of course.
The airline says my lost suitcase is 'enjoying an adventure'. How thoughtful of them.
Good morning! I just woke up.
Hey, I'm back! Did you miss me?
Hi there. It's my first time talking to you, so... nice to meet you.
I need to head to bed now. Good night!
Okay, I've got to run to work. Talk later!
This is my last chat before I go travelling for a month. I'll miss you!
Your advice yesterday was spot on. It totally worked!
You solved my riddle on the first try! How did you do that?
I got the job!!! They called me an hour ago!
I finished my first marathon. Five hours, but I did it!
Why did the scarecrow win an award? Because he was outstanding in his field.
I tried to impress my date by juggling eggs. Three seconds later there was omelette on the ceiling, the dog and my date.
If you could live in any era of history, which one would you pick?
Here's a riddle: what has keys but can't open locks?
Guess what? I just found out I have a twin I never knew about.
Did you know octopuses have three hearts and blue blood?
What's the boiling point of water in Fahrenheit?
How many minutes are in three and a half hours?
What's the plural of 'cactus'?
Which time zone does Tokyo use?
How many teaspoons are in a tablespoon?
How do you spell 'necessary'?
What's the capital of Canada?
Convert 20 degrees Celsius to Fahrenheit, please.
Not much going on today. Just doing laundry.
I'm making some tea. Back in a minute.

turns: Hey. Long day.
Honestly, this whole week has been rough.
My manager moved our deadline up by three days without asking anyone.
And then the printer jammed right before my presentation. Of course it did.
I ended up presenting from my phone. It was a bit of a disaster.
Sorry, I'm just dumping all of this on you.
Thanks. It helps to say it out loud.
On top of that, I've barely slept. Maybe five hours a night.
Any tips for winding down when my brain won't stop?
The breathing one sounds weird, but I'll try it.
Okay, I tried it. Weirdly, it kind of worked.
Also, my neighbour's dog has started howling at six every morning.
I'm starting to think the dog has a better sleep schedule than me.
Anyway. Tomorrow I have to ask my manager for more time on the project.
What if she just says no?
How should I phrase it so it doesn't sound like I'm complaining?
Okay, let me try: 'To do this well, I need until Friday.' Better?
Alright. Wish me luck.
...I'm back. Guess what?
She said yes! I've got until Friday!
And she actually thanked me for raising it early.
I can't believe I was so worried about it.
You were right about being direct, by the way.
I think I'll treat myself to takeout tonight. Noodles or pizza?
Noodles it is.
Oh, an old friend from university just texted. She's in town this weekend.
We haven't seen each other in four years.
Do you think it'll be awkward after so long?
Thanks for sticking with me through this week.
Okay, I'm off to get those noodles. Good night!
Hi! I've got some exciting news.
I'm finally taking a holiday next month. Two whole weeks!
I can't decide between a beach trip and hiking in the mountains.
What would you pick?
Good point. Mountains, then.
What should I pack for a week of hiking?
I don't own proper hiking boots. Do sneakers count?
Fine, fine, I'll buy boots.
Here's a confession: I've never actually camped before.
What if a bear shows up at my tent?
Okay, that's less scary than I imagined.
Also, I've decided to take up watercolour painting on the trip.
I've painted exactly once. It looked like a soggy potato.
How do you even start with watercolours?
Wait, do you paint the light parts first or last?
Huh, that's backwards from what I thought.
I just did a practice sky. It's... a sky. I guess.
Actually, the second try looks way better!
I even added little birds.
My sister says my birds look like flying commas.
Rude, but fair.
Should I bring my sketchbook or buy a new one there?
Do you think I can paint the sunrise from the summit?
Okay, I'll set an alarm for half past four. Ugh.
Can you keep a secret? I'm going to paint something for my sister as a thank-you.
Don't tell her about the commas comment, though.
I think I've got everything planned now.
Thanks for helping me figure all this out.
I'll tell you all about it when I'm back.
Bye for now!
